applicableAreas: Electrical transformer pad locations west of Buildings 1, 5, and 6
findings.comment: Four electrical transformer pads are proposed; only the pad west of Building 8 is depicted within a dedicated easement boundary labeled 'Vault Easement.' The transformer pads west of Buildings 1, 5, and 6 lack shown easement boundaries on site plan sheets. All Austin Energy facilities must be shown within dedicated electric easements.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along OHE line
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows multiple trees proposed directly adjacent to and overlapping the Overhead Electric (OHE) line marked along the southern boundary and southeast corner where the 5' electric easement is located. No license agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement is documented in the project submittal for landscaping and trees proposed within the electric easement. Applicant must obtain executed license agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement.

applicableAreas: Site grading plan in proximity to Overhead Electric line shown on southern boundary
findings.comment: Grading changes are proposed throughout the site (Sheet 11), and Overhead Electric (OHE) lines are shown along the southern property boundary (Sheet 31). The required note stating 'Owner/developer is responsible for all costs associated with raising electric lines and attachments if final grades do not meet required clearances for Austin Energy facilities and franchised attachments' is not present on the cover sheet or electric notes sections. This note must be added.

applicableAreas: Limits of construction and 100-foot radius around moonlight tower (if present)
findings.comment: Applicability of this requirement depends on whether moonlight tower or associated guy wires are within 100 feet of the limits of construction. This determination requires geospatial data regarding moonlight tower locations that is not available in the submitted site plan documents. Applicant must verify moonlight tower proximity using City of Austin geospatial data and submit evidence of compliance or obtain required plan note.
